name: talview
description: Talview frontend delivery ecosystem — enforcement gates, ticket-to-PR pipelines, verification, review, and self-learning for Claude Code.

plugins.name: talview-core
plugins.description: Deterministic guardrails: edit-time lint feedback, definition-of-done gate, evidence-gated push. The layer that cannot be skipped.

plugins.name: tlv
plugins.description: Intake router plus feature, bug, sentry and tech-debt tracks that carry a ticket from audit through ADR to an open PR.

plugins.name: talview-verify
plugins.description: Browser, network and accessibility verification that produces evidence artifacts, not claims.

plugins.name: talview-review
plugins.description: React/TypeScript code quality rubric, applied both before writing and when reviewing a diff.

plugins.name: talview-learn
plugins.description: Harvests PR review feedback into enforceable rules and routes each lesson to lint, hook, skill or CLAUDE.md.
